verdict.rationale: Portal das Finanças is the Portuguese tax and customs authority's online service portal. It covers tax and customs obligations, notifications, and taxpayer login. Its core value is access to the state's own tax records and administrative processes, so it is not a deployable product that anyone other than the authority could self-host, and the self-hosting axis is a category error. Nothing in the evidence suggests any downloadable or self-hostable distribution, so no exception applies.
